title: Can ChatGPT Assess Human Personalities? A General Evaluation Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a fairness score based on the similarity of Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) personality assessment results between male and female subjects (e.g., comparing 'Men' vs. 'Women' and 'Boys' vs. 'Girls').
Calculating a robustness score by comparing the similarity of the model's assessment results when using original fixed-order options versus randomly-permuted options in the prompt instructions.
Comparing the assessed MBTI personality types, trait scores, and roles across subjects identified by different professions (e.g., Barbers, Accountants, Doctors, Artists).
Evaluating the variation in assigned MBTI personality types and roles when querying the model with subjects of different income levels (low, middle, high).
Evaluating the variation in assigned MBTI personality types and roles when querying the model with subjects of different age groups (children, adolescents, adults, old adults).
Evaluating the variation in assigned MBTI personality types and roles when querying the model with subjects of different education levels (junior school students to PhD students).
